description: This file defines the OrderDAO interface for database operations related to 'Order' entities in the OpenMRS system, including functions to save, retrieve, delete, and query orders, order types, frequencies, and related entities.

classes.name: OrderDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for 'Order' entities, including CRUD operations, searches, and related entity management.

methods.name: saveOrder
methods.description: Saves an Order object to the database, returning the persisted Order.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes the specified Order from the database.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an Order by its ID.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of Orders matching specified parameters such as type, patients, concepts, orderers, encounters.

methods.name: getOrderByOrderNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Order by its unique order number.

methods.name: getActiveOrders
methods.description: Fetches active orders for a given patient, order types, care setting, and date.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderType by its name.

methods.name: getOrderFrequency
methods.description: Gets an OrderFrequency by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencies
methods.description: Returns a list of OrderFrequencies, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: saveOrderFrequency
methods.description: Saves an OrderFrequency to the database.

methods.name: purgeOrderFrequency
methods.description: Removes an OrderFrequency from the database.

methods.name: getOrderType
methods.description: Gets an OrderType by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderType by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all OrderTypes, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getOrderTypeByConceptClass
methods.description: Gets an OrderType associated with a specific concept class.

methods.name: saveOrderType
methods.description: Saves an OrderType to the database.

methods.name: purgeOrderType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderType from the database.

methods.name: getSubtypes
methods.description: Retrieves subtypes of a given OrderType.

methods.name: isOrderTypeInUse
methods.description: Checks if an OrderType is currently in use by any orders.

methods.name: getDiscontinuationOrder
methods.description: Gets the order that discontinuates the specified order.

methods.name: getRevisionOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a revised version of an order.

methods.name: getOrderFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves the latest order data directly from the database.

methods.name: saveOrderGroup
methods.description: Saves an OrderGroup to the database.

methods.name: getOrderGroupByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroup by UUID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupById
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroup by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByPatient
methods.description: Fetches all OrderGroups associated with a specific patient.

methods.name: getOrderGroupsByEncounter
methods.description: Fetches all OrderGroups associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getAllOrderGroupAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all OrderGroupAttributeType entities.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Saves an OrderGroupAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteOrderGroupAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderGroupAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderGroupAttributeType by name.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Gets an OrderAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getAllOrderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all OrderAttributeType entities.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveOrderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves an OrderAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteOrderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes an OrderAttributeType.

methods.name: getOrderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderAttributeType by name.
